description:
We aim to explore how MODIS and VIIRS satellite data can be combined to better identify, analyze, and monitor fire hotspots. Our goal is to develop a practical solution that makes satellite data easier to understand and helps provide useful insights into fire detection and monitoring.

We are interested in using our skills in software development, data analysis, and technology to tackle this challenge. We believe in sharing ideas, and working together to turn our ideas into something meaningful.
